technical.summary: Strong structural bullish alignment with golden cross and price above all major MAs, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 91, Stoch 95) and stochastic bearish cross create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dip rather than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: KO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 78 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying by junior member, broad market fear (44 Fear/Greed score) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (251.5) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 78 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational KO.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above all major MAs and bullish supertrend/OBV provide structural uptrend confirmation, supported by broad market fear creating contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 91, Stoch 95 with bearish cross), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and high earnings risk within 78 days create imminent pullback risk that outweighs technical structure.
